normalization_plan.reason: paidAmount is a transient local holding msg.value only meaningful inside the purchase function
nextToken is a transient local copy of _nextId scoped to the purchase flow
remainingTokens is a loop-local supply counter used only within the batch purchase
to is the recipient parameter of buyTokenTo and collapses into the mint call
newValue is the value parameter directly stored into the additional data of setSomeBool
a and pow are derived randomness locals used only to populate _additionalData during the purchase loop
tokenId is the token identifier parameter consumed by the internal transfer routine
